headline: Bid openings for Oak Hill Park tennis courts and playground renovations, plus Veterans Pool construction and police purchases.
summary: The agenda lists bid openings for Oak Hill Park tennis courts and playground renovations. It also lists road salt, a fence contract amendment, advertising for Veterans Pool construction, and police ammunition, shields, vests, computers, and uniforms.
